error[ZC-E0122]: zcube local can't find or start the server or agent
  while  starting the local zcube-server
  cause  zcube-server is not an executable file in
         <state>/bin
  fix    build them and run zcube from the directory they are in:   zig build && zig-out/bin/zcube local up
  more   zcube explain E0122
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0122.html
